rows.text:
Ines Okafor is the new keeper of the Salt Ledger on the island. Aldous Brandt was the previous keeper who disappeared three weeks ago. Ines Okafor must finish the audit before the equinox market.

Tobiah Wren informs Ines Okafor that the previous keeper, Aldous Brandt, did not simply leave. Tobiah Wren gives Ines Okafor a brass key with a fish-shaped bow. Tobiah Wren warns Ines Okafor to trust the tide tables less than the water itself. Mara Venn reveals that the spring pages of the Salt Ledger are missing. Mara Venn states that the torn pages were found the morning Aldous Brandt disappeared. Anselm Pike informs Ines Okafor that he has played chess with Aldous Brandt for eleven years. Ines Okafor went to the net loft to find anyone who had worked with Aldous Brandt. Mara Lisle revealed that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping and went to the salt warehouse at night with a lantern. Mara Lisle stated that Aldous Brandt came back from the warehouse with chalk on his sleeves while counting barrels. Ines Okafor counted the salt in the warehouse for four days. The ledger showed forty barrels arrived monthly while receipts listed sixty-four.

Ines Okafor dropped the handbill in the stove and continued working. Ines Okafor dismissed the strange notice as a prank by dock boys. What does the handbill instructing the reader to lie about Mara Lisle mean?

Ines Okafor is the new keeper of the Salt Ledger on the island. Aldous Brandt was the previous keeper who disappeared three weeks ago. Mara Lisle is the girl who sat in the net loft mending a trawl. Mara Venn is the Harbourmaster who leads Ines Okafor to the archive. Ines Okafor must finish the audit before the equinox market. Ines Okafor must carry her salt count tally to the council in the morning.

Tobiah Wren informs Ines Okafor that the previous keeper, Aldous Brandt, did not simply leave. Tobiah Wren warns Ines Okafor to trust the tide tables less than the water itself. Mara Venn reveals that the spring pages of the Salt Ledger are missing. Mara Venn states that the torn pages were found the morning Aldous Brandt disappeared. Anselm Pike informs Ines Okafor that he has played chess with Aldous Brandt for eleven years. Ines Okafor went to the net loft to find anyone who had worked with Aldous Brandt. Mara Lisle revealed that Aldous Brandt stopped sleeping and went to the salt warehouse at night with a lantern. Mara Lisle stated that Aldous Brandt came back from the warehouse with chalk on his sleeves while counting barrels. Ines Okafor counted the salt and found twenty-four barrels missing from the ledger. Ines Okafor found a handbill instructing her to state that Mara Lisle stole the ledger pages. Mara Venn refused Ines Okafor's request to open the salt warehouse without a council order. Ines Okafor copied her salt count onto a single sheet showing forty barrels in the book and sixty-four on the receipts. Ines Okafor worked late in the archive until a little before midnight. Someone entered the archive at the foot of the tower and climbed the stairs. Ines Okafor searched the archive again at first light hoping her tally had fallen behind the desk. Ines Okafor found that her tally sheet had not fallen behind the desk when she searched again. Dr Anselm Pike found Ines Okafor on the tower steps and expressed his concern for her. Dr Anselm Pike made Ines Okafor sit down and listened to her entire story with his hands folded.

Dr Anselm Pike offered Ines Okafor a strongbox in the dispensary to hide her receipts tonight. Dr Anselm Pike mentioned that Mara Venn has kept the seal on the ledger for a long time. What does Dr Anselm Pike mean when he says Ines Okafor has met the harbourmaster's coat?
